converter.author: obdopqo
changes: Rasterize only font cmap pages and defined characters; retain original raster/thinning/stroke simplification algorithms.
Skip unsupported codepoints to avoid replacing fallback CJK with .notdef glyphs.

record_format: BMP character + 2 hex advance units + 3 hex packed points, M separates strokes; 64 units/normalized glyph height
provenance: Consolas Regular first, Microsoft YaHei Regular second, original PTE records last. Microsoft YaHei is face 0 from the local Windows msyh.ttc collection. Only defined BMP glyphs are converted. Original TTF/TTC files are not included in the source tree.
license: Consolas and Microsoft YaHei retain their original font licenses. The converter MIT declaration does not license font data. Original PTE fallback provenance is retained separately.
